decision_consumer: decide whether full MSI changes feasibility or material behavior relative to competent kernel-page-cache and minimal-synchronous-direct peers
objective: Execute one correctness- and cache-matched Qwen3-Next P/D/F campaign at an aggregate-nonresident 11 GiB host budget, then either preserve a differentiated integrated-mechanism result or narrow the paper to its auditable evidence contract and engineering contribution.
claim_boundary: One RTX 3090, one Qwen3-Next Q4_K_M artifact, one untouched 8192-token prompt, greedy 128-token generation, per-layer LRU64, and the exact binary and resource contracts below. No serving, multi-GPU, cross-hardware, broad-workload, race-freedom, or general optimality claim follows.

runtime_identity.sampler: greedy with every EOG token masked to negative infinity for the frozen fixed horizon

qualification.eog_policy: mask all EOG tokens and force exactly 8 greedy outputs

campaign.eog_policy: mask all EOG tokens and force exactly 128 greedy outputs
campaign.prompt_selection: untouched support-preserving natural prompt selected before Qwen3-Next campaign output was observed

matched_invariants: one adapter binary with a source-arm selector
same GGUF bytes and native expert qtypes
same stock graph, router, expert consumer, destination, greedy sampler, and object order
same independent per-layer LRU64 cache and final-state instrumentation
fresh process and complete cgroup per cell
same 8192-token prompt, EOG-masked fixed 128-output horizon, and n_ubatch 4096

P.source: blocking buffered pread with pages first charged in the claim cgroup
P.stop_rule: stop P descendants after the first evidence-valid cell that reaches the host limit, loses required margin, swaps, OOMs, or incurs any memory.max event

D.source: blocking O_DIRECT with one fixed registered aligned payload window and one fixed aligned scratch envelope

F.source: bounded asynchronous O_DIRECT through eight registered windows

correctness_oracle.source: blocking buffered pread with extent-local POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED after each read
required_exact: complete-vocabulary float logits for all 128 output steps

churn_predicates.outcome_blind_rule: Preserve a failure of any predicate; do not select a replacement prompt or extend output length after observation.

repetition_rule: Execute one P cell until its frozen stop rule fires; execute all six preordered D/F pairs. No outcome-selected resampling.

paired_metrics: decode physical source bytes per post-prefill output
estimands.interval: two-sided 95% Student-t interval on the mean paired log ratio with df=5, back-transformed
estimands.performance_eligibility: Correctness, resource, and lifecycle admissibility are required. Frozen churn failure remains a primary negative but does not erase otherwise valid paired timing.

terminal_rules.F_failure: Withdraw the strong integrated novelty claim if F fails frozen exactness, resource, lifecycle, or repetition requirements.
terminal_rules.D_matches_F: If D matches F in feasibility and material behavior, publish MSI primarily as rigorous open-source engineering and an auditable evidence contract.
terminal_rules.P_fails_D_and_F_pass: Conclude that direct source ownership changes feasibility; attribute Plan novelty only to demonstrated performance or fault behavior.
terminal_rules.P_and_D_fail_F_pass: Preserve the strongest architectural result: the complete MSI design changes feasibility.

success_condition: An evidence-valid full MSI population is oracle-exact, resource-admissible, lifecycle-balanced, clears all churn predicates in every cell, and materially separates from competent D in paired behavior or later deterministic integrated fault handling.
next_decision: Execute the integrated deterministic fault campaign only if a meaningful residual integrated-mechanism claim survives this campaign. Qwen3.6 MTP and integrated Gemma populations remain deferred until that publication fork is resolved.
